# Shmoop

> Educational platform offering study guides, test prep, and college planning resources with a focus on literature, biblical texts, mathematics, and academic success.

Shmoop provides comprehensive learning materials spanning biblical studies (Old Testament books like Ezekiel, Judges, Leviticus, Daniel, Kings), standardized test preparation (AP Statistics), math intervention programs (RTI for grades 3-8), and college admissions guidance including financial aid and essay writing support.

## Key Topics

- Biblical studies and Old Testament analysis
- AP test preparation and standardized testing
- College financial aid and FAFSA guidance
- Mathematics and linear algebra
- Response to Intervention (RTI) programs
- Individual responsibility and biblical justice
- Hebrew Bible and ancient Israel
- College admissions and essay writing
- Literary allusions and cultural references
- Righteousness, repentance, and biblical themes
- Educational assessment and intervention
- Prophetic texts (Ezekiel, Daniel)
- Historical books (Kings, Judges)
- Levitical law and ritual practices

## Test Preparation & Academic Programs

- [AP Statistics 2020](https://www.shmoop.com/ap-statistics-2020): AP Statistics exam prep with College Board-aligned practice & review
- [Shmoop Math RTI](https://www.shmoop.com/math-rti): Response to Intervention program for grades 3-8 math assessment & support
- [Matrices Study Guide](https://www.shmoop.com/study-guides/matrices): Linear algebra guide covering matrix operations & Cramer's Rule basics

## College Planning & Financial Aid

- [What is Financial Aid](https://www.shmoop.com/college/what-is-financial-aid.html): Guide to FAFSA, scholarships, loans, grants & Federal Work Study programs
- [Private vs. Public vs. Community College Costs](https://www.shmoop.com/college/private-public-community-college-costs.html): Tuition comparison: private, public, community college & transfer options
- [Non-Traditional Age College Essay](https://www.shmoop.com/college/non-traditional-age-college-essay-what-matters.html): Essay prompt guide for non-traditional students on delayed dreams

## Biblical Prophets & Wisdom Literature

- [Book of Ezekiel Chapter 18](https://www.shmoop.com/study-guides/book-of-ezekiel/chapter-18-summary.html): Ezekiel Ch.18: God's teaching on individual responsibility & righteousness
- [Book of Daniel Chapter 9](https://www.shmoop.com/study-guides/daniel/chapter-9-summary.html): Daniel Ch.9: Gabriel's seventy weeks prophecy & prayer for Jerusalem
- [Book of Daniel Trivia](https://www.shmoop.com/study-guides/daniel/trivia.html): Daniel trivia: Aramaic/Hebrew text, Darius & the lion's den story
- [Book of Numbers Chapter 24](https://www.shmoop.com/study-guides/book-of-numbers/chapter-24-summary.html): Numbers Ch.24: Balaam's prophecy blessing Israel despite King Balak

## Biblical Historical Books

- [1 Kings Chapter 2](https://www.shmoop.com/study-guides/1-kings/chapter-2-summary.html): 1 Kings Ch.2: David's death & Solomon's succession with political intrigue
- [2 Kings Chapter 7](https://www.shmoop.com/study-guides/2-kings/chapter-7-summary.html): 2 Kings Ch.7: Elisha's prophecy & miraculous end to Aramean siege
- [Amon in 2 Kings Character Analysis](https://www.shmoop.com/study-guides/2-kings/amon.html): Character analysis: King Amon of Judah, son of Manasseh, father of Josiah
- [Book of Judges Allusions](https://www.shmoop.com/study-guides/book-of-judges/allusions.html): Cultural references to Book of Judges in Milton, Pope & pop culture

## Torah & Levitical Law

- [Leviticus Chapter 3](https://www.shmoop.com/study-guides/leviticus/chapter-3-summary.html): Leviticus Ch.3: Peace offering (shelamim) ritual instructions for Israelites
- [Leviticus Trivia](https://www.shmoop.com/study-guides/leviticus/trivia.html): Interesting facts about Leviticus, Torah law & Maimonides' teachings

## New Testament Studies

- [1 Corinthians Chapter 9](https://www.shmoop.com/study-guides/corinthians/1-chapter-9-summary.html): 1 Corinthians Ch.9: Paul's apostolic rights & sacrifice for gospel ministry

## Optional

- [University of Illinois--Urbana-Champaign (Chinese)](https://www.shmoop.com/university-of-illinois/cn): UIUC campus profile in Chinese: academics, Fighting Illini & student life
